images.name: hello-v2
images.prompt: Edit the first reference image, the white slime waving hello. Keep the same white slime silhouette, black pill-shaped eyes, happy open smile, outline thickness, flat illustration style, scale and transparent background. Change ONLY the raised hand/arm on the right: replace the two-pronged mitten shape with ONE smooth elongated rounded capsule-like stub arm, like Kirby's simple fingerless arm. One single rounded tip, no fingers, no thumb, no split or fork, no hand lobes. The arm emerges naturally from the body and points diagonally upward in greeting. Keep the rest of the body and face unchanged. True transparent alpha background, no scenery, no text, no shadow.

images.name: sad
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new SAD reaction emoji belonging to the exact same white slime family as the references. First reference is the original avatar identity; second reference shows the reaction illustration style and outline thickness. Preserve the squat rounded dome body with gently flattened bottom, pure white body, smooth black outline, black simple pill-like eyes, no legs, no ears or hair. Sad expression: two slightly drooping black oval eyes, small downward-curved black mouth, a single small blue teardrop at the outer corner of one eye. Tender, clearly sad, not distressed or dramatic. No arms required. Flat minimal 2D cartoon, recognizable at 48px, match the existing emoji style. Centered on square canvas, body around 60% of canvas width, generous transparent padding. Pure white body for later recoloring, only the tear is blue. Genuine transparent alpha background. No painted checkerboard, no ground shadow, no scenery, no captions, no gradients or 3D.
